name: Adriano Santos
action: Adriano looks at the young man, then at his glue-covered hands, and says, 'Give me two minutes to get this drum stable, then you can look at the kit. I'm not leaving a half-tensioned head like this.' He turns back to the tom and begins tightening the tension rods.
reason: Adriano's immediate reaction mixes irritation at the rushed interruption with his established habit of not turning away a serious buyer. His methodical, craft-focused nature makes him unwilling to leave the half-tensioned tom in a risky state, but his resistance to losing a potential sale pushes him to offer a short compromise. The memory of a previous buyer who rushed and later haggled reinforces his caution, so he demands a brief wait to secure the drum before showing the kit. His speech and action directly express this tension: he does not reject the buyer, but he prioritizes the instrument's integrity over the buyer's urgency.
